company.name: BKash
company.shortDescription: BKash is a mobile financial service platform that offers subscription payments, instant refunds, direct charges, and B2C payout services.
company.description: BKash Limited, a subsidiary of BRAC Bank, started as a joint venture between BRAC Bank Limited, Bangladesh and Money in Motion LLC, USA. In April 2013, International Finance Corporation (IFC), a member of the World Bank Group, became an equity partner and in April 2014, Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation became the investor of the company. The ultimate objective of bKash is to ensure access to a broader range of financial services for the people of Bangladesh. It has a special focus to serve the low income masses of the country to achieve broader financial inclusion by providing services that are convenient, affordable and reliable

productsAndServices.description: A mobile financial services platform for sending, receiving, storing, and using money through a bKash account and app in Bangladesh.
productsAndServices.name: bKash Mobile Financial Services Platform

productsAndServices.description: A mobile application for opening and managing a bKash account and accessing bKash payment, money-transfer, bill-payment, savings, and other financial services.

productsAndServices.description: A person-to-person money transfer service that lets bKash customers send funds instantly to another bKash account or mobile number.
productsAndServices.name: Send Money

productsAndServices.description: A digital payment service for paying online and at participating merchants using the bKash app, merchant accounts, or QR codes.
productsAndServices.name: Payment

productsAndServices.description: A cash-withdrawal service that lets customers withdraw money from bKash agent points and supported partner bank ATMs.
productsAndServices.name: Cash Out

productsAndServices.description: A funding service for adding money to a bKash account from a linked bank account or supported payment card.
productsAndServices.name: Add Money

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $591 to $293,561,442, a 496719.87x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 87 (-4 over 90 days) and market heat at 77 (+15).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
